# Solo Chief of Staff

Your assistant runs a fixed daily rhythm for your one-person business: a morning trend brief in your niche, a task-setting check-in where at least 1 of 3 jobs must be revenue-linked, and an evening review that carries unfinished work into tomorrow instead of dropping it. Set it up once with 6 questions; it then runs on schedule or on demand. It never sends, posts, or spends without your approval.
